synopsis.text: The Avengers head to the deserts of New Mexico to investigate an unprovoked attack on Warren Worthington, and his girlfriend Candy Southern. Yellowjacket attempts to reconcile with Jan, but she has already motioned for divorce.

This comic continues from the previous issues, Hank Pym is still in a state of distress after the court case and the Wasp is still thoroughly angry. The other members in the team also have a range of feelings towards the subject.
Meanwhile, Ghost Rider attacks the mutant Angel, and soon after the Avengers are called upon to stop the rogue villain.
Features the Hostess Cup Cakes ad, Spider-Man's Dream Girl!
Bob Budiansky was uncredited as Assistant Editor. This would be his last issue in this position and is replaced by Lance Tooks for the next issue.
